verdict.rationale: Appwrite's own self-hosting docs explicitly promise "Full control over data location." It can run anywhere Docker or a Kubernetes cluster (via the official Helm chart) runs, and you can migrate between Appwrite Cloud and self-hosted, so you can choose residency by hosting it yourself. Nothing in the evidence shows region selection or data-residency options on managed Appwrite Cloud, so residency control requires running your own infrastructure. missing for 10: documented region/residency selection for Appwrite Cloud projects, a list of available regions or residency guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration of residency control.
